articles.title: Trump threatens ban on Bombardier as Canada's retaliatory tariffs kick in
articles.description: Canada's retaliatory tariffs of up to 50 percent on approximately $19.8 billion worth of US goods came into effect this Tuesday, further escalating the trade war between the two neighbours. At the same time, US President Donald Trump is threatening to ban sales of all Bombardier aircraft in the US, in spite of the Canadian company's deep web of US suppliers. Also in this edition: Iran raises the price of gasoline and French startup Mistral AI is now valued at €21 billion.

related.title: Trump threatens to ban Canadian Bombardier jets from US market
related.description: US President Donald Trump threatened on Monday to block sales of Canadian planemaker Bombardier in the United States unless it builds aircraft in the country, escalating trade tensions on the eve of Canadian retaliatory tariffs. Trump accused Canada of “unjust and unfair” trade practices but did not explain how a ban would work.

articles.title: 🔴 Live: At least two killed in Kyiv as Russia renews strikes after three-day pause
articles.description: Russia resumed strikes on Kyiv late Monday after a three-day pause ordered by President Vladimir Putin expired, Ukraine’s emergency service said. Kyiv's city military administration said at least two people were killed and seven wounded. The halt coincided with visits to Moscow and Kyiv by US President Donald Trump’s envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, who were holding talks aimed at ending the war. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

articles.title: Canada's counter-tariffs take effect on several US goods as trade war reignites
articles.description: Canada's counter-tariffs on billions of dollars in US products took effect Tuesday, as a trade war between the two countries heated up. Ottawa's pushback comes weeks after US President Donald Trump imposed 50-percent tariffs on a similar value of Canadian products, over what Washington deemed as "discriminatory treatment" against US alcohol, automobile and dairy industries.

articles.title: Présidentielle 2027 : l’hypothèse d’une primaire agite encore la droite et le bloc central
articles.description: Face à la perspective d’être absentes au second tour du scrutin présidentiel, plusieurs figures macronistes ou des Républicains plaident pour un mode de départage organisé. Si Edouard Philippe refuse d’en entendre parler, Gabriel Attal et Bruno Retailleau laissent l’idée prospérer.

articles.title: UAE leader warned Netanyahu of Hamas attack days before October 7, says report
articles.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu faced strong backlash from opposition leaders on Tuesday after a report published by Haaretz newspaper said UAE President Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan warned Netanyahu that Hamas was planning a major operation days before the attacks on October 7. articles.title: Houthi attacks disrupt Saudi oil facilities and wound more than 70
articles.description: Attacks on Saudi Arabia Tuesday claimed by Yemen's Houthis wounded more than 70 people and ignited fires at several oil facilities and utilities in the kingdom's southern region, authorities said, in a major escalation in the renewed conflict between an important US ally and the Iranian-backed rebels.

articles.title: L’Iran brandit la menace d’une escalade militaire pour briser le blocus américain

Le régime iranien pourrait être tenté de mettre à profit la perspective des élections américaines de mi-mandat pour augmenter la pression militaire sur l’administration Trump.

articles.title: French AI startup Mistral valued at over 21 billion euros after latest funding
articles.description: French AI company Mistral announced Tuesday that it had raised three billion euros ($3.5 billion) in what it described as the largest-ever European tech fundraising, valuing the startup at over 21 billion euros. While still an upstart compared to the AI giants OpenAI or Anthropic, Mistral says it is carving a niche by offering models that companies can run themselves with their own data.

Colombia is the first stop on a tour designed to bolster pro-US leaders and cement influence over the continent.

articles.title: Paris looks to profit as Céline Dion fans flock to French capital
articles.description: Céline Dion’s hotly anticipated return to the stage is scheduled for this Saturday in Paris - the first of more than 16 concerts in the French capital in September and October. The shows mark a major milestone for 58-year-old Dion after years away from touring due to the rare neurological disorder. A total of 500,000 spectators are expected in Paris - a huge windfall for the economy, especially for the hotel, restaurant, and transport industries.

articles.title: France, South Korea pledge 1 billion euros to support cinema amid AI threat
articles.description: Hollywood star George Clooney and executives from US studios such as Sony Pictures and Disney were among the 200 guests that gathered in the south of France for a summit on the future of cinema on Monday. As part of the initiative, co-hosts France and south Korea have pledged 1 billion euros to safeguard against threats to the industry, particularly from AI.
